scientific_question: Can camera-block leave-one-out predictive inflation, computed only from the current observations and reported Low-64 geometry response, provide a fail-closed direct-K11 certificate across the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 and Case 2 conditions?
role: post-open development diagnostic on already opened BLASTNet Cases 5 and 2

conditions.name: blastnet_case5
conditions.role: known-safe one-class calibration with leave-one-rig-out evaluation

conditions.name: blastnet_case2
conditions.role: cross-condition scoring whose truth is unavailable until decisions are sealed

observable_before_truth_barrier.full_fit: Compute the unregularized Moore-Penrose Low-64 fit from all nine camera blocks.
observable_before_truth_barrier.camera_block_press: For each camera j, refit Low-64 on the other eight camera blocks and predict the completely held-out block j.

primary_certificate.name: camera_block_PRESS_inflation
primary_certificate.zero_observation_rule: Every observation norm must be strictly positive; otherwise execution is invalid.
primary_certificate.rank_rule: The full response and every eight-camera response must have numerical rank 64; otherwise execution is invalid.
primary_certificate.cardinality_boundary: This diagnostic is frozen only for the current nine-camera roster and does not establish 5/7/12-camera behavior.

cheap_control.name: full_fit_relative_residual
cheap_control.role: If the single full-fit residual passes, it explains any PRESS headroom without nine reduced fits.

case5_only_calibration.order_statistic: For each fit rig with n frames, sort scores ascending and take index ceil(0.1*n)-1.
case5_only_calibration.threshold: Maximum of the per-fit-rig order statistics so every fit rig contributes at least the fixed utility fraction; equality accepts.
case5_only_calibration.case5_evaluation: For each held-out Case5 rig, rebuild the threshold from the other twelve rigs only.
case5_only_calibration.case2_evaluation: Build one threshold from all thirteen Case5 rigs and apply it unchanged to Case2.

truth_visible_adjudication.safe_definition: Direct Low-64 PCGLS K11 passes every frozen absolute per-cell gate and every ratio to Zero-PCGLS K16 is at most 1.05.

truth_visible_capacity_labels.truth_role: Truth and reference metrics are deserialized only after both scores, thresholds, and all decisions are exclusively sealed.

independent_validation.second_feature_solver: normal-matrix eigendecomposition rather than formal response SVD
independent_validation.second_PRESS_path: explicit camera and frame loops rather than formal batched residual accumulation
independent_validation.second_threshold_path: manual stable sort and explicit rig loops

decision_order: invalid execution or independent mismatch -> INCONCLUSIVE
primary safety, per-rig utility, physical accuracy, or per-rig cost failure -> close the block-PRESS certificate
primary pass and cheap control pass -> control explains the development headroom
primary pass and cheap control fail -> post-open block-PRESS development headroom only
